name: Sweet Amber
objectiveText: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak . Bundle of Charred Oak  ( 1 )

comments.body: 54,50 u can go there without a fight. just enter searing gorge from badlands, follow the road to the south and when u see a camp of dwarf on the left side of the road, go to the right side. it is like a burn tree

comments.body: I would like to add that the tree is found not in the canyon, but on top overlooking the canyon on the eastern side.

Bundle of Charred Oak is found in Searing Gorge, I got mine at 54,51 on a edge looking over into Cauldron

comments.body: 5600 XP and no reputation adjustments. I completed this at level 47.
Check in Searing Gorge. On the eastern side of the actual gorge/deep canyon like area there is a tree you can click on.
replies:
Searing Gorge, the Cauldron-
ON THE MAP, below the "L" in Cauldron. If the cauldron were filled with water, the edge would form a peninsula due south of the "L" on the map, right on the edge (not in the hills), there is a rock with smoke rising behind it.  There is a fallen tree behind it as well, BINGO.

comments.body:
I noticed nobody mentioned how to get to the Searing Gorge. I have never been there before and you need key to go there from Loch Modan.  But if you keep asking the person there at the locked tunnel entrance, they will let you know there is another entrace through the Badlands.
Enter the Badlands, then head to the far eastern section of the zone. There is a path south of Kargath (horde stronghold) that will lead you into the Searing Gorge. From there, just go to the coordinates listed in the above post.
I'm a lvl 47 warrior and had no problems getting to the tree and getting out. coords are 54,50
There is a charred oak tree at 55,51 in seering gorge.  Its pretty easy to get to if you run straight there from the entrance in the badlands.

This is where you find your quest item in Searing Gorge  : [object=50982 domain=classic]

To enter searing gorge from Badlands go West, around the equator of the zone.

To those confused about getting parts before/after you have the pervious part done:

This quest involes a Truesilver Bar in the first place, which means yes, it does require things that can be used outside of the quest chain. the same goes for the Holy Spring Water. i discovered the spring in my 30's, and always kept a spring water with me because it was a free health/mana pot. i am now 58 and i am doing this quest. i can confirm that the Holy Spring Water is not an item only obtainable on the quest, as goes for the truesilver bar, but the rest are quest-pickup only.
It's rather well hidden behind that big boulder. It's NW of the Grimeslit digsite, on a ledge that juts noth over the Cauldron. A mithril vein spanws there all the time, might help the miners out.
Sigh, 54,50 works fine for me as well.. but just remember to go back to Westfall to get the next part of this stupid quest BEFORE you wander all over the zone trying to find the burning tree.. :p
This is located in Searing Gorge. Go through the tunnel in Loch Modan if you can and follow the path. You should be able to find it near the pit.
Tree is behind big boulder just north of the dwarf campsite near the outhouse quest.
/tloc 54.50 confirmed......quest works just fine...for the ones without cosmos use above indications :P

well, its a lot of xp and gold for bout an hour of travelling, exluding battles for more xp and cash.. so its good imho.

though westfall is out of the way. =P
The tree is on the south edge of the cauldron on a point sticking out north, almost straight west from the badlands enterance

If you enter SG from the gate you stay on the path until just past where the blue spiders are. Follow the lip of the gorge and you'll run into a huge gray rock. The charred oak is just on the other side. If you FP in you'll have to go to the other side of the gorge. If you enter from the connecting zone you just stay on a straight line. You can't miss it.

If you look on your map and see the piece of land jutting under the words "The Cauldron" - you will find a burning tree (and yes there is also a mithril deposit nearby).  It is not at all far from Grimesilt's camp.

I would just recommend paying a rogue to open the door from Loch Modan, much faster that way.

I went to the Searing Gorge coordinates and didn't see anything clickable either.  After running around a few times, I was just about to give up, when the tree became clickable.  It could be that the respawn rate for this is very long (maybe a couple of hours).  If someone has just tagged this earlier, you may not be able to get it.  I'd make sure you go on an off-hour.  

PS, the other posters were correct.  There's very little mobs in the way.  As long as you have mount, you should totally be able to do this.
FOTV is correct and the directions in that post were the most understandable. 55,51 SOUTH side of Cauldron...I spent a long time on the wrong side. The oak is next to a large rock and is smoking.

I went to 54,51 in Searing Gorge, but I couldn't find any openable items to collect the bundle.  I figured it was a bug, so I went all the way back to westfall to abandon and re-accept the quest.  Now that I'm in Searing Gorge again, I still can't get the charred oak.  I know I'm in the right location - is this just a bug?

This is actually the easiest part!
For those of you wandering how to go to Searing Gorge for the first Time, the way is not through Loch Modan (the gate is locked) but through the Badlands in the wester end at the middle there's a path up the hill taking you there.
If you have Herbalism as you skill this is a nice place for fireblooms.
By the way the item you need is at cosmos 54,51. No monster is nearby and it's just that easy to pick it up.
Stick to the main road and you'll never have a problem with mobs jumping on you.
